purpose: Create the first nationwide node-level population proximity baseline for all 146 approved MRT-area candidates without representing straight-line proximity as travel time or final accessibility.
population_allocation: Allocate each MP2019 subzone age-7-16 population proxy in proportion to the share of its EPSG:3414 polygon intersecting the union of buffers around every preserved exit for the station complex.
claim_boundary: Outputs are spatial proximity proxies only. They are not transit or walking travel-time results, observed demand, enrolment, customers, a shortlist, a ranking recommendation or evidence of success.
